Label: Claim/claim-line date of service
Definition (Validated from Protocol): The date of service for the claim or claim-line. For medical claims: FST_DT (first/service date) from T_MEDICAL. For pharmacy claims: FILL_DT (prescription fill date) from T_RX. Equals DATE_SERVICE_SOURCE. Filtering rule: Keep only claims in MMA_[MED] where DATE_SERVICE >= INDEX_DATE and DATE_SERVICE <= ENDDATE (inclusive). Date variable.
Additional Notes (Validated from Protoco: Protocol Section 4.3 (Observation Period): Follow-up begins on the index date and ends at the earliest of death, health plan disenrollment, or end of study period (30 June 2025). All treatment claims must fall within this observation window. Deduplication rules: (1) If a patient has multiple claims for CLAIM_TYPE = pharmacy on the same DATE_SERVICE for the same [MED], keep the claim with max DAY_SUPPLY. (2) If a patient has multiple claim-lines for CLAIM_TYPE = medical on the same DATE_SERVICE for the same [MED], keep only one. (3) A patient is allowed to have BOTH a pharmacy and a medical claim on the same DATE_SERVICE for the same [MED]. Patient-level MMA_[MED] datasets are created containing only processed claims for each specific medication from eligible cohort patients.
Optum CDM Implementation: T_MEDICAL: FST_DT field (date of service / beginning date for service being billed, Numeric YYMMDD10 format).
